narrative.intro: MVM recorded $234M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. MVM won 6 awards this fiscal year and the average award size is $39.1M. Obligations are up 26.0% year over year. The Department of Homeland Security accounted for $234M of obligations in FY2026 to date. Security Guards and Patrol Services accounted for $234M of obligations in FY2026 to date. Historical obligations show variation: FY21 obligations were $497M, FY22 obligations were $769M, FY23 obligations were $303M, FY24 obligations were $344M, and FY25 obligations were $186M. Current-year totals are partial because the figures reflect fiscal year to date activity. All figures are contract obligations except award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values.
